description.value: Maple Beach Bed and Breakfast is a guest house located in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on Maple Street, a short distance from the waterfront. As a bed and breakfast, it offers a more personal hosting experience than a hotel. Its location near the Seaside Greenway and Point Grey cycling routes makes it a convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch failed with a Cloudflare 522 timeout error, so no website content is available to confirm amenities. All amenity fields must rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and wheelchair=no, but no cyclist-specific amenities are indicated. The business appears to be a real, operational bed and breakfast in Vancouver based on OSM data.
concerns: Website fetch failed with Cloudflare 522 Connection Timed Out error — all amenity fields are unverifiable from website content.
url_discovery_status is 'no_web_presence' despite a website URL being present in OSM tags; this may indicate the site is intermittently unreachable or the domain has lapsed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real B&B with a physical address and contact details in OSM; website fetch failed due to server timeout but the business does not appear closed or phantom.
